items.t: Goldman Sachs (GS) Takes Over Radford Studio Center
items.sum: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) led a lender syndicate that took ownership of Radford Studio Center after a defaulted mortgage auction credit bid. The Radford Studio Center transfer gives the lender group control of a major Los Angeles production facility that has been linked to potential discussions with Netflix.
